text: 日本央行审议委员浅田统一郎：日本央行不直接管理汇率，因此无法就美元兑日元处于何种水平较为合适置评。 即使日本央行政策利率达到符合其政策目标的水平，央行仍可能在此基础上进一步加息或降息。 希望在每次政策会议上综合评估上行和下行风险以及金融条件，再作出政策决定。 目前无意提议降息。 中性利率有可能略高于日本央行目前的政策利率水平。 我并不反对加息。 未来某个时候，我们可能需要缓步上调利率。 我们若要加息，必须谨慎把握加息步伐。
text_en: Bank of Japan Policy Board member Asada Toshiro: The Bank of Japan does not directly manage exchange rates, so it cannot comment on what level of the dollar-yen exchange rate is appropriate. Even if the Bank of Japan's policy rate reaches a level consistent with its policy target, the central bank may still raise or cut rates further on that basis. He hopes to comprehensively assess upside and downside risks and financial conditions at each policy meeting before making policy decisions. At present, he has no intention of proposing a rate cut. The neutral rate may be slightly higher than the Bank of Japan's current policy rate level. He is not opposed to raising rates. At some point in the future, we may need to raise interest rates gradually. If we are to raise rates, we must carefully grasp the pace of increases.
